description:

The Soviet Union has left behind many great abandoned buildings and structures. Georgia, the birthplace of Joseph Stalin, was no exception. I've explored a bunch of old Soviet things since I left Russia and came to Georgia, and it's time to do it again! Under the USSR, the Georgian town of Tskaltubo became the site of many Soviet resorts and sanatoriums: over 20 were built with Stalin himself overlooking the construction. I have already visited a Stalinist Soviet sanatorium in Sochi, Russia, and in today's video we'll explore the abandoned Soviet resorts of Georgia! We'll also check out the city of Kutaisi, some ancient caves, drink wine with a local Georgian man and get into some trouble. Hope you enjoy this vlog and subscribe for more! Thx xoxo
